customers_say: Customers find the water purifier easy to install and appreciate its good taste, clean output, and great service. However, the reliability and durability receive mixed feedback - while some say it works well, others report it stops working after 4 months and won't last more than a year. Moreover, opinions are divided on water wastage, with some claiming zero waste while others consider it a gimmick. The value for money is also mixed, with some finding it worth the price while others say it's not budget-friendly.
